title: Fix the Bug: The Loop That Never Ends
hints: Trace the loop: what happens to `i` when `continue` runs?
`continue` skips the `i -= 1` at the bottom, so `i` never moves. A `for`-`in` loop can't forget to advance.
jsBridge: A `while` loop whose `continue` skips the increment hangs in JS too. Swift nudges you towards `for … in` over collections or `stride`, where the language owns the counter and this bug can't happen.

compass.q: `for x in items.reversed()` vs an index-based `while`: which bugs does each make impossible?
In JS, `for…of` vs `for (let i…)`: do you reach for index loops more in JS than you need to in Swift?
An infinite loop on the main thread freezes the UI. What does iOS do to an app that hangs too long (watchdog)?
How did the judge detect the infinite loop? What does TLE mean in terms of process signals?
